preconditions.description: The number of employees n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of dislike relationships m must be between 0 and 100,000.
The number of salary revisions q must be between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in dislikes)
preconditions.description: Each dislike relationship must involve valid employee indices and a_i must not equal b_i.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in revisions)
preconditions.description: Each salary revision must involve a valid employee index.

postconditions.description: The output must contain q + 1 integers representing the number of dangerous triples at the beginning of each day.
Each output integer must be non-negative.
